answer: Standing decay: an identity's weight in rewards, votes and juries fades each round unless it is renewed with fresh graded work. Attackers usually build up a stockpile of sleeper accounts and wake them all at once for a vote or a payout, but under decay every sleeper has to keep paying for original answers every round just to stay alive, or it fades like a plume of smoke. Keeping a thousand fakes ready is a voyage with no end: real work spent every round, with each lantern going dark the moment the work stops.
